symbols.name: cleanQueryString
doc: I clean the search query but strictly preserve everything the search pipeline depends on:
- The DOUBLE QUOTE (") — it is the case-insensitive whole-word trigger, so it must survive to the router / API.

- Literal punctuation that appears inside real circular content and is routinely searched: . - / @ : # & ( ) , and _ (e.g. "Rs.500", "HR-CLC/MERIT_AWD/2026/131", "bams.saildsp.co.in", "affdf@icici"). Stripping these would break literal/quoted lookups.
I collapse only genuinely junk characters (control glyphs, stray symbols/dingbats) to spaces.
